caption: The drawing features several components of what appears to be a doll. At the top center, there is a frontal view of a doll’s head and partial upper torso, with brown, wavy hair and large, round eyes. The skin is painted with a pale pink tone, with significant areas where the surface appears chipped or worn, revealing a lighter color beneath. Below this, in the middle of the composition, there is a separate illustration of a dismembered leg on the left, colored pale cream with a black boot, and a dismembered arm in the center, colored pale pink with shading and faint detailing of fingers. Both limbs are partially detached at the joints. In the bottom right, there is a profile view of the same doll’s head and upper torso, again showing the brown wavy hair, pink skin tone, and some chipped areas on the face. The background is a plain off-white color. The words "ACTUAL SIZE" are written below the frontal view of the doll’s head and torso.
title: Doll
